# Ease India Trip

> > Ease India Trip offers curated tour packages across India, specializing in heritage tours, hill stations, backwater cruises, and spiritual journeys through Rajasthan, Kerala, Uttarakhand, and the Himalayas.

Ease India Trip is a comprehensive travel planning platform featuring multi-day itineraries spanning India's diverse destinations—from the royal palaces of Rajasthan to the serene backwaters of Kerala, Himalayan hill stations, and temple pilgrimage circuits. The site caters to first-time visitors, families, photographers, and cultural enthusiasts with packages ranging from 3 to 14 days.

## Key Topics

- Rajasthan heritage tours
- Kerala backwater tourism
- Hill station packages
- Uttarakhand family tours
- Spiritual and temple tourism
- Himalayan destinations
- Houseboat cruises
- Cultural tours
- Buddhist monasteries
- Ayurvedic treatments
- Photography tours
- Golden Triangle itineraries
- South India pilgrimage
- Northeast India exploration
- UNESCO World Heritage sites

## Rajasthan Heritage Tours

- [6 Days Rajasthan Jaipur Jodhpur Udaipur](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/tour-packages/6-days-rajasthan-jaipur-jodhpur-udaipur.html): 6-day Rajasthan heritage tour: Jaipur, Jodhpur & Udaipur palaces
- [14-Day Rajasthan Tour Package for First Timer India Trip](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/tour-packages/14-day-rajasthan-tour-package-for-first-timer-india-trip.html): 14-day Rajasthan first-timer package: Golden Triangle & desert safari
- [4 Days Udaipur Tour with Chittorgarh](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/tour-packages/4-days-udaipur-tour-chittorgarh.html): 4-day Udaipur tour with UNESCO Chittorgarh Fort visit
- [Pushkar Tour Packages](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/rajasthan/pushkar): Pushkar spiritual tours: Brahma Temple, Pushkar Lake & Camel Fair

## Kerala Backwater & Coastal Experiences

- [Kumarakom Tour Packages](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/kerala/kumarakom): Kumarakom backwater tours: Vembanad Lake houseboats & bird sanctuary

- [Kannur Tour Packages](https://www.easeindiatrip.com/india/kerala/kannur): Kannur Kerala tours: beaches, Theyyam rituals & historical forts
